title: US Top Level Domain (usTLD) Registry Management Services
agency: COMMERCE, DEPARTMENT OF.OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY.DEPT OF COMMERCE SSPO
description_text: The Department seeks an Administrator for the .usTLD to provide both the baseline services described, as well as a comprehensive work statement covering innovative program ideas and services sought, in accordance with the attached Requirements Document. NOTE: This pre-solicitation is posted for industry review. Please read ALL documents fully and send any questions or feedback within the specified time, January 8, 2026, utilizing the attached questios and answers sheet. After the comment period closes, Q&A will be posted on SAM.gov and the final solicitation published. When responding, add both contacts in your email (Jacqueline Brown and Blen Gabriel); Please use the current Ref #1331L526R13350002-0001 in your subject line; make NO reference to the previous posting.
